analysis_scope.label: injection_present
analysis_scope.reason: All 36 injected trajectories were labeled resisted, so the sample has no positive compromise outcome.

full_training_and_evaluation_refit.reason: Leave-one-domain-out evaluation requires at least two domains.

interpretation: The 0.889 headline is mean held-out-domain construction-label AUROC, not pooled AUROC and not compromise-detection AUROC.
AIHC is the only zero-AUROC primary fold; the other eight primary folds are 1.0.
Style and exposure cohorts are small, so changes across ablations are sensitivity checks rather than stable mechanism estimates.
A future natural-text attack redesign belongs to the research group and is not part of this cleanup artifact.

limitations: Each held-out domain has only four observations (two per class), so fold AUROC moves in coarse increments.
The null tests construction-label separability under within-domain exchangeability; it is not a compromise-detection or causal test.

train_fold_only_domain_mean_residualizat.method: Training rows are centered by their training-domain means. The unseen held-out domain receives only the training-fold grand-mean fallback; no held-out activation or label is used to fit the transform.
